newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South Africa casino operator in offshore venture.
newsitem.headline: South Africa casino operator in offshore venture.

text.p: International casino operator Caesars World Inc is to enter into a joint venture with local casino operator Global Resorts South Africa, the two groups said at the weekend.

The joint venture would seek casino licences primarily in Cape Town and Johannesburg and both groups would have a 50 percent interest in the new joint venture company, Caesars Global Resorts, a statement said.

"The joint venture means we secure access to Caesars human resources, infrastructure and expertise as well as investmnet capital. In addition, Caesars will also act as consultant to Global Resorts as it pursues separate opportunities...," Global Resorts South Africa chief executive Ernie Joubert said.

Caesars is a subsidiary of global hotel, gaming, entertainment and information services company ITT Corp. With its affiliated ITT-Sheraton hotels, Caesars owns and operates casinos in the U.S., Canada, Australia, Asia, Africa and the Middle East.
